messages:
IncidentBot: [ALERT] model-quality-regression detected for route /v1/generate (model: rwd-3b-v2). Threshold breached: quality_score_down 18% vs baseline. Triggered at 2026-03-12T03:04:37Z :rotating_light:
Leah Morris: I'm on it, picking up the pager. Quick check — is this across all regions?
Priya Patel: seeing spikes in error/reject rate in us-west-2 and eu-central. Not global, but affects ~24% of requests to that model.
Marco Rivera: looking at deploy logs now. A canary deploy completed at 02:50 UTC to rwd-3b-v2. Canary metrics showed an anomaly but didn't cross alert threshold.
Leah Morris: ok, triage plan: 1) Confirm customer-visible impact 2) If quality regression confirmed, rollback canary -> full rollback to rwd-3b-v1 or pin for affected customers 3) Draft status page + customer note.
Jesse Kim: I can draft customer comms. Which customers are impacted?
Priya Patel: top-impacted tenants: acme-inc, finlytics-prod, learnly. Mainly high-length generation (>1024 tokens) and system-prompt heavy flows.
Marco Rivera: attaching quick snippet of failing diffs (copied logs):
```
[2026-03-12T02:53:12Z] request_id=abc123 seq=... model=rwd-3b-v2 quality_delta=-0.21 prompt_len=1432
[2026-03-12T02:53:12Z] eval_metric=toxicity_score increased +0.14
```
Leah Morris: thanks. Looks like quality reg (semantic drift) for long sequences. Priya, can you check if automatic KV-cache optimization in recent runtime patch could be interacting?
Priya Patel: yes, runtime patch `prefetch-kv-v2` landed in the canary image. We reverted in a staging build and didn't see regressions earlier, but we didn't test combination with long prompts.
Marco Rivera: probable interaction between kernel selection + quantization path. For mitigation: two options — rollback model to rwd-3b-v1 globally OR pin affected customers to v1 and roll back canary runtime change. Which has lower blast radius?
Leah Morris: immediate priority is to stop customer-facing regressions. Fastest is to pin affected customers to v1 and roll back the runtime canary. Global model rollback is heavier and affects new improvements.
Ops Pager: ETA for pin action?
Marco Rivera: can push customer-level pin in ~6 minutes, runtime rollback of canary in ~12. I'll start both in parallel.
Leah Morris: do it. Post the commands you run here. Also capture release IDs for audit.
Marco Rivera: running pin command now:
```
# pin tenant to model v1
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/internal/v1/tenants/acme-inc/pin -H 'Authorization: Bearer _ops' -d '{"model":"rwd-3b-v1","reason":"quality_regression_20260312"}'
```
Marco Rivera: response ok for acme-inc and finlytics-prod. learnly had a transient auth issue, retrying.
Marco Rivera: runtime canary rollback command queued:
```
# rollback canary image
deployctl rollback --service runtime-canary --to-image runtime:v1.9.17
```
Priya Patel: rollback started, nodes draining and replacing - monitoring.
Leah Morris: status page draft for review: 
"We are investigating a model quality regression affecting some generation requests for rwd-3b-v2. Some customers may see reduced output quality on long-form prompts. Engineers are pinning impacted tenants to rwd-3b-v1 and rolling back a recent runtime canary. We will update within 30 minutes."
Jesse Kim: suggested customer-facing note (short):
"We are investigating an issue affecting a subset of long-form generation requests. We've applied a temporary fix for impacted customers and are rolling a runtime rollback. No action required on your side. We will follow up with timeline and remediation details."
Leah Morris: +1. Add link to status page and contact for urgent cases. Use support@redwood.ai for replies.
StatusBot: Draft status update queued to high-priority incidents page. Preview link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/preview/1782256677
Leah Morris: internal comm template (for leadership):
"Summary: Quality regression in rwd-3b-v2 impacting ~24% of traffic to that model, triggered by recent runtime canary. Mitigation: tenant pins applied to major customers and runtime canary rolled back. Impact: potential degraded quality on long-form prompts for affected customers. Next steps: run regression test suite on pinned combination and root cause analysis. ETA for full recovery: 30-60m. POC: Marco Rivera (eng-runtime)."
Marco Rivera: runtime health metrics are trending back to baseline as drained nodes replaced. No further anomaly after canary rollback so far.
Priya Patel: long prompts for learnly still showing aberrant outputs, I'm going to force their pin again and run a sample eval.
Marco Rivera: pinned learnly successfully. Sample evals look similar to pre-deploy baseline for acme-inc and finlytics-prod.
Leah Morris: good. Let's publish the status page update now with the draft message, mark "investigating -> Identified" and add affected customers in the notes.
StatusBot: Status page updated: Incident 1782256677 state=Identified posted 2026-03-12T03:14:22Z
Jesse Kim: sending customer template to top impacted customers now. cc'ing support leads.
Jesse Kim: message to customers sent for acme-inc and finlytics-prod. learnly message pending until we confirm sample evals.
Leah Morris: handoff: I'm on-call until 03:45Z, then Marco will take over for the post-mortem and RCA. If there is any regression recurrence, page me immediately.
Marco Rivera: taking the post-incident RCA. I'll start collecting diffs between kernel selection for v1 vs v2 and the canary runtime changes.
Priya Patel: note for RCA: include test matrix for prompt lengths >1024 and system-prompt heavy flows.
Leah Morris: post-incident internal comm (to #eng-sre, #product, #cust-success):
"Incident 1782256677 summary: rwd-3b-v2 experienced quality regression for long prompts after a runtime canary. We pinned affected tenants to rwd-3b-v1 and rolled back the runtime canary. Immediate customer impact mitigated. Action items: (1) full RCA with kernel+quantization traces (assigned Marco) (2) add long-prompt test harness to canary gating (assigned Priya) (3) run tenant-level sweep to verify pins and update audit logs (assigned Leah)."
Ops Pager: recording incident for on-call logs. Duration so far ~11m.
Leah Morris: thanks team. I'll leave this thread open for any follow-ups and the RCA links once Marco posts them. :thumbsup:
Marco Rivera: will post RCA doc and timeline in this thread when ready.
Jesse Kim: will prepare a short customer-facing postmortem to send to impacted customers after RCA is complete.
StatusBot: Incident 1782256677 marked as Monitoring at 2026-03-12T03:25:57Z
Leah Morris: closing handoff notes — next update due by 03:45Z or earlier if regression reappears.
Marco Rivera: acknowledged, taking over for post-incident work.
